candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Catalogues
verified_facts: The record describes indices for full-coverage LIDAR surveys of England.
The catalogue record itself currently exposes no downloadable data service or resource.
The record is published by the Environment Agency under an open-government licence context.
semantic_limits: A catalogue/index record is provenance context only; it cannot be sampled as elevation and cannot prove that a required raster tile exists or was used.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: SurfZone Digital Elevation Model (DEM) - 2m
verified_facts: SurfZone DEM is a 2m inter-tidal model combining LIDAR with near-shore multibeam bathymetry.
The product uses feathering across survey overlaps and bilinear interpolation for small gaps.
Its metadata index identifies source survey, surface type, coastal region, geoid and transformation lineage.
semantic_limits: A coastal merged DEM with bathymetry/interpolation is not a substitute for the SHA-bound inland bare-earth LiDAR DTM parcel sample.
